Game Overview

In Galactic Annihilator, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the neon chaos of Galactic Annihilator. Face relentless waves of glowing adversaries, collect exhilarating power-ups, and unleash destruction. Skillfully navigate through the vibrant arcade chaos, perfect your aim, and strive for the ultimate high score as you protect the galaxy.
